versions.summary: Albums, voice scrubbing, forwarding through the chat list, fixes after 0.4.0.
new: Forwarding opens the chat list itself, with folders, as on the main screen
A file from a chat can be saved to Downloads
Pinned messages show who wrote them
“Later” on the 24-word screen at first launch
Backspace in the emoji panel keeps deleting while held
Tapping “Forwarded from …” shows the author’s full key, ready to copy
Privacy policy — in About and on the first screen
Pinned chats can be reordered: “Reorder” in a pinned chat’s menu
Voice messages and audio can be scrubbed along the waveform
Photos sent together arrive as one album; “Group” toggle in the attachment panel
Fast scrolling in the attachment panel gallery, with the photo’s month
Edit time in the menu of an edited message
Privacy indicators are set up at first launch
Copying several messages keeps each one’s author and time
Message times follow the phone’s 12- or 24-hour setting
The online status is off by default; it can be turned on in Privacy
fixed: An answered call the other person left first is no longer “declined”
A forwarded attachment shows up as the last message in the chat list right away
The emoji panel fits above the keyboard together with the message field
A chat opened from a notification over another one no longer shows the other chat’s avatar
A new folder starts without “Direct” turned on; Saved can be added to a folder
“Share contact” gives a code the contact can be added with
A message to an offline recipient is marked “queued” right away
A hidden online status is no longer shown on one’s own profile either; the chat list and profile show “Reachable”
An album is selected as a whole, by tap and by drag
A queued message is marked with a cloud in the chat list too

versions.summary: Updates arrive by themselves, a changelog in the app, a reminder about background activity.
new: Update check: once a day, only with consent; download and install from the chat list
“What’s new” after an update and in About
“Background activity” reminder in the chat list: on Xiaomi it opens Battery saver directly
Swipe right in a chat — back to the chat list
A gallery photo in the attach panel opens full screen
Emoji groups switch with a sideways swipe
fixed: A crash in the chat feed when replying with a quote
In groups, the last message of a block no longer stands apart
Selecting a message no longer highlights the gap below it
Fast scrolling loads older messages in time
Scrolling no longer starts swipe-to-reply
Newer Android libraries and Yggdrasil 0.5.15

versions.summary: Third beta: fixes and wishes from the second round of testing.
new: Clear attachments by chat and by type
Groups look like direct chats; “reachable” in groups
Reactions and delete confirmation in Saved messages
Quick reactions follow use
Profile photos open in the common viewer
fixed: A crash in the chat feed during screen transitions
Smoother scrolling in long chats, the APK is ~10 MB smaller
Android 7–9: the attach panel no longer spends memory on full-size photos

versions.summary: Second beta: fixes and wishes from the first days of testing.
new: Two statuses: “online” and “reachable”
Formatting in messages
The full emoji set, search by words
Selecting messages by dragging
Pinned messages, tap to jump
fixed: A large download no longer delays messages
Attachments keep their proportions; camera photos are no longer on their side
The “Connecting to network” screen is gone: chats open at once

versions.summary: First public beta of Peerage: a messenger without servers.
new: Direct chats, groups, files, voice messages and calls, end-to-end encrypted over the Yggdrasil mesh
